capabilities.description: Extracts and holds the contract clauses and BOQ item lines as the governed source of record, preserving item codes, units, quantities, rates and clause numbers so no downstream figure is hand-entered.
requirements: Use the uploaded contract and BOQ as the source of record

capabilities.description: Builds interim progress claims by measuring executed quantities against BOQ items at their contract rates, totals them into an Interim Payment Certificate, and applies Clause 14.3 retention of 5% per certificate with 50% released at Taking-Over and 50% at the end of the Defects Notification Period.

Tracks elapsed time against the 730-day Time for Completion from the Commencement Date, records delay events, and calculates Clause 8.7 delay damages at 0.1% of the Accepted Contract Amount per day, hard-capped at 10% of the Accepted Contract Amount.
Holds Inspection and Test Plans and their inspection records against project items, with sign-off, hold points, and audit-trailed evidence of each completed inspection.
Maintains the controlled register of project documents with revisions, issue status and linkage to the BOQ items and contract clauses they serve, and exports register reports.
Presents the project's commercial position in one view: certified to date, retention held and released, remaining time, accrued delay damages against the cap, and ITP status by activity.
Audit capability (reused from the block store)
Documentation capability (reused from the block store)
Notification capability (reused from the block store)
